comment: vCard's full inventory and its grammar, from two pinned authorities: RFC 6350 (the same text app/specs/oracle/spec.json pins) and IANA's vCard Elements registry. tools/oracle/vcard.py derives the page's property table and the test examples from them. A registry entry neither implemented nor exercised is listed in debt with a reason; debt only shrinks.

sources.title: RFC 6474 vCard Format Extensions: Place of Birth, Place and Date of Death
RFC 6715 vCard Format Extensions: Representing vCard Extensions Defined by the Open Mobile Alliance (OMA) Converged Address Book (CAB) Group
RFC 8605 vCard Format Extensions: ICANN Extensions for the Registration Data Access Protocol (RDAP)
RFC 9554 vCard Format Extensions for JSContact
RFC 9555 JSContact: Converting from and to vCard
RFC 7852 Additional Data Related to an Emergency Call

debt.name: property XML
debt.why: RFC 6350 6.1.5 gives no example of it, and its value is an XML fragment (RFC 6351) with no example to derive from
